instruction.name: armrotri.w
instruction.description: ARM-style rotate right by immediate on 32-bit values.

latencies.notes: rd -> rd chain. Raw slope-method measurement was 2.01; the nominal value is 2 cycle(s).

experiments.name: operand dependency chain
experiments.notes: rd -> ARMFLAGS chain closed by armmfflag; 1 cycle subtracted.

latencies.notes: rd -> ARMFLAGS chain closed by armmfflag; 1 cycle subtracted. Raw measurement was 3.06; the residual is a systematic +0.03..0.1 calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread. Raw slope-method measurement was 3.00; the nominal value is 3 cycle(s).

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: armrotri.w $r12, 1, 14; armrotri.w $r13, 1, 14; armrotri.w $r14, 1, 14; armrotri.w $r15, 1, 14; armrotri.w $r16, 1, 14; armrotri.w $r17, 1, 14; armrotri.w $r18, 1, 14; armrotri.w $r19, 1, 14
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 10 --init 'armmtflag $r0, 0x39' --asm 'armrotri.w $r12, 1, 14; armrotri.w $r13, 1, 14; armrotri.w $r14, 1, 14; armrotri.w $r15, 1, 14; armrotri.w $r16, 1, 14; armrotri.w $r17, 1, 14; armrotri.w $r18, 1, 14; armrotri.w $r19, 1, 14'
throughput.notes: 8 independent lanes take 16.00 cycles, i.e. 2 CPI. The instruction is a single uop; its conditional execution limits it to one per two cycles (armmfflag and armmove are not conditional on register data and run at one per cycle). Re-measured on 2026-11-17 on LA664, core 0, with --method slope (--unroll 250 --unroll2 1000) and confirmed with the 0x01 uop counter.

notes: LBT ARM-style instruction. Latency is recorded per register source operand and for the ARMFLAGS path.
